definitions.explanation: Among the very best or most prominent in a given category. Used to describe something or someone that ranks at the top. Literally means 'bending the fingers' (to count the best).

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名門|めいもん}→名門：11955_meimon⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧だ。
examples.english: It is one of Japan's leading prestigious universities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a company with world-class technical capabilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{米|こめ}どころ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This region is known as one of the country's leading rice-producing areas.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{屈指|くっし} is used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. The typical pattern is X{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧Y (one of the top Y in X), where X is a scope (country, world, region) and Y is the thing being praised.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "bending the fingers" — the idea of counting the best on one's fingers, implying there are so few at the top that you can count them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — one of Japan's top/leading
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — world-class, world-leading
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — one of the country's foremost
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧{屈指|くっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — leading in the industry
